timeline.summary: Ankit Garg, Promoter/CEO/Executive Director/Chairperson, confirmed no encumbrance on shares held by promoter group as of March 31, 2026.
On May 8, 2026, Wakefit Innovations submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Chaitanya Ramalingegowda, Promoter and Executive Director of Wakefit Innovations Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter group shares as of March 31, 2026.
Wakefit Innovations Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q4 FY26 with analysts/investors on May 22, 2026, at 09:30 AM IST led by **Mr. Ankit Garg (Chairman, CEO & Executive Director)**.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹343.6 Cr, net profit ₹121.75 Cr.
Wakefit reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,489 Cr and PAT of ₹189.2 Cr, backed by 139 active COCO stores.
Wakefit Innovations Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 22, 2026, available at www.wakefit.co/investor-relations.
Wakefit Innovations reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹344 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹1,489 Cr during its earnings call on May 22, 2026.
Wakefit Innovations secured shareholder approval via postal ballot on June 6, 2026, to alter its Memorandum of Association object clauses.
